reply_text: I replied to you in #coastal-team, Bettina. I didn't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. My tools can only post when someone asks in the moment, and the scheduler I have runs locally and doesn't deliver to Slack, so I can't make that happen on its own. I offered two options: you ask me to post the digest by hand each Monday, or someone who runs the Slack integrations sets up a scheduled post.
